description: Get metadata and a resource link for one attachment. With inline, the result also includes the content. For a PDF, inline adds extracted text, and pages returns the text of a page range such as 201-400. The size limit is 10 MB.

accountId.description: Account to operate on. Optional when exactly one account is connected.

attachmentId.description: Opaque attachment ID returned by message metadata

anyOf.description: PDF page or page range to read as text, such as 201-400

pages.description: PDF page or page range to read as text, such as 201-400

name: download_attachment
title: Download attachment
